review.evidenceBasis: Checked all 41 mapping rows (41 videos, lessonRef null) against the Edexcel IAL M2 spine (1.1-5.2), title-only evidence, applying the higher cross-subject physics->maths-mechanics bar. All bindings are title-evidenced: projectile motion and independence of horizontal/vertical components (1.2), centre of mass/gravity (2.1, 2.2), work/KE/GPE/power/conservation (3.1, incl. 'Elastic, Inelastic Collisions' whose elasticity framing directly matches the restitution/KE-loss spec 4.2), momentum/impulse (4.1), moments/couples (5.1); calculus specs 1.3/1.4, lamina equilibrium 2.3, successive impacts 4.3 and rigid-body ladders 5.2 are correctly unbound. Freefall practicals -> 1.1, drag -> 3.1 and GCSE/KS3 conservation-of-energy rows are genuine partials already at low and stay; no spec-level rejects.
